//Purpose: CloudFilm Orthanc configuration. Structure only - every secret is injected as an ORTHANC__* environment variable by docker-compose, so this file is safe to commit.
//Role: Orthanc is a transient staging cache in front of the hospital archive, never a system of record.
Name: CloudFilm Orthanc
//Access: Reachable on the internal Docker network only; never published to the host or the internet. Credentials come from ORTHANC__REGISTERED_USERS__*.
//Dimse: The DIMSE server is disabled by default. Enable it only for a hospital that pushes studies to CloudFilm.
//Plugins: DICOMweb is what OHIF speaks. PostgreSQL replaces the embedded SQLite index so the deployment is backed up and scaled with the rest of the database tier.
//Postgres: Host, port, database and username are structural. The password arrives as ORTHANC__POSTGRESQL__PASSWORD.
//Housekeeping: Bounded storage: Orthanc recycles the least recently used studies once the cache exceeds this size, in megabytes.
//Safety: CloudFilm never anonymises or edits studies in place; the hospital archive remains authoritative.
